decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY for the independent internal-link instruction; the image-count change adds no linking-state change.
Specifying the stuffed-dolls blog image count does not change its established Gen Z target audience.
The image-count instruction does not change the number or type of blog articles to be delivered.
The existing publication prerequisite already requires all required images to be added; the image count is owned by the image Requirement and does not require duplicated publication state.
The stuffed-dolls blog image count does not alter keyword selection or replacement rules.
The image-count instruction does not change topic-selection or topic-revision constraints.
The image-count instruction is unrelated to the keyword report's count, search-volume data, and replacement keywords.
The matched count terminology is incidental; the blog image count does not affect backlink quantity or link-type ratio.
The article-specific image count does not change the SEO plan's required service areas or exclusions.
